objective: Test component parity only after an exact evaluator short-circuit for current immediate wins and positions where every legal nonwinning move leaves an immediate opponent win.

exactness_scope.W: current mover has an immediate winning action
exactness_scope.L2: current mover has no immediate win and every legal action either is nonterminal with an immediate opponent win next; terminal draw/current win prevents L2

classification: evaluator preprocessing, not a claim that Q itself may inspect arbitrary future ranks
anti_circularity: Only current q_o plus its exact one-step transition is used.
No solved value or future-equivalence class defines W/L2/O.
Post-RFG components and parity valuation remain frozen.
stopping_rule: If T2 makes MOD2 parity Q-V sufficient across all frozen cases, record a bounded hybrid evaluator candidate. If not, inspect the next exact counterexample before adding machinery.
